newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOSHOKU KEEPS FALLING ON LOAN CANCELLATION.
newsitem.headline: TOSHOKU KEEPS FALLING ON LOAN CANCELLATION.

text.p: Shares of Japanese foodstuffs trader Toshoku Ltd continued to decline on Tuesday morning, following the previous day's sharp fall, weighed down by the news on Friday that it would forgive 49.41 billion yen worth of loans to its wholly owned finance unit.
At 0044 GMT, Toshoku's shares were down 13 yen at 137 yen, making the issue the top percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse. Its volume was 1.996 million shares.
Toshoku said on Friday it had decided to forgive its loans to the unit as part of a restructuring of the unit's business.
